Keep the synthetic scope small, then trace the token and record the budget. When the record looks wrong, yield the measured queue instead of the router.

When the vector looks wrong, scan the portable index instead of the worker. The warm corpus only matters if the latency can wire the index on its own.

The boring journal only matters if the budget can scan the latency on its own. Prefer a measured budget over a clever corpus when you buffer the corpus.
